description: Variation of condition Nos.3 & 4 (Refuse and cycle storage) of planning permission ref: P1599.17 dated 13/09/2018 to allow for relocation of storage units (Sub-division of existing flats to form 7no additional units)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the approved plans (as set out on page one of this decision notice).
For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved.

Within 2 months of the date of this decision, the proposed refuse and recycling facilities shall be provided in accordance with the details shown on Drawings Ref: '03 - PROPOSED DRAWING - LEVEL 2 REV B' (dated 10/06/2026) and '04 -Waste collection point Equitable House' (dated 24/07/2026) and in accordance with the strategy set out in the letter submitted by Ridge and Partners LLP dated 14/07/2026, together with the accompanying Bin Schedule/Capacity Schedule Rev D. The refuse and recycling facilities shall be permanently retained and managed in accordance with these details thereafter.
Reason: To protect the amenity of occupiers of the development and also the locality generally and ensure that the development accords with Policy 35 of the Havering Local Plan.

Within 2 months of the date of this decision, the proposed cycle storage shall be provided in accordance with Drawing Ref: '02 - PROPOSED DRAWING - LEVEL 3 REV B' (dated 10/06/2026). The cycle storage shall be permanently retained thereafter.
Reason: To ensure that cycle storage is made permanently available and in the interests of providing a wide range of facilities for non-motor car residents and sustainability.

The use hereby permitted shall cease and all equipment and materials brought onto the land for the purposes of such use shall be removed within 4 months of the date of failure to meet any one of the requirements set out in (i) to (iv) below:-

i. within 4 months of the date of this decision, details of a scheme shall be submitted for the written approval of the Local Planning Authority, which specifies the provisions to be made for the control of noise effecting  the site from nearby and/or adjacent commercial premises, specific consideration should be afforded to noise arising from venues associated with the late night economy. The scheme shall include a timetable for its implementation and confirm compliance with British Standard 8233: 2014 'Guidance on sound insulation and noise reduction for buildings', Table 4 and the associated Notes 1 to 7.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, improvements required to make the proposal acceptable were negotiated with Ridge and Partners LLP via email on 8th, 16th and 23rd July 2026. The revisions involved altering the application form and the refuse/recycling information and providing a map of the waste collection point. The amendments were subsequently submitted on 14th, 21st and 24th July 2026.
